title: CryptoCredly
tagline: A decentralized dapp for professional credentialing to help devs verify their skills in a competitive tech market.
description: A completely decentralized Credly clone that will help bring ownership to credential hodlers and owners across the world to verify work and skill. This is a passion project I am excited to bring to market. I have seen many centralized systems take hold over credentialling but I think the power should be in the hands of the people who took the credentailling.
how_its_made: NEXTjs with TypeScript front-end; LENS/Solidity/Polygon backend; Moralis for database and Solidity and Moralis help to handle the blockchain interactions. It uses hard-typed TypeScript in the back-end to ensure gthe app in production is sound and also helps to ensure typed for blockchain transactions is covered as well.
